svg.aria-label: thai-mock-naming: Thai mock names, fake on sight. Real Thai text for the code to handle, and one grep finds every row. Steps: Generate, marker names from approved tokens; Seed, fixtures, samples, demo users; Lint, real-looking names flagged on edit; Find, grep the marker, clean up. Output: no test row mistaken for a real person.
